reviews.comment: One of the best econ professors at A&M, class is super applicable. Show up to class and take notes over everything, and the tests wont be very hard. Super applicable material, and super interesting.

This class has easily been one of my favorite classes at TAMU! Yes, it is a difficult class, and you absolutely need to go to the lectures and take notes to be successful but they're engaging and comprehensive. I truly learned so much and a lot of it was relevant to current events. Dr. Puller is the best and I can't recommend this class enough!!!

Dr. Puller did an incredible job of explaining the informational and facilitating class discussion. The class was critical thinking based. Discussion during class made it easier to understand and process the information, pay attention in class. If you pay attention during class and understand the information you only need to review before the exam.
reviews.ratingTags: Respected--Skip class? You won't pass.--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Dr. Puller did a great job at really breaking down the material in a way that was easy to understand and did a good job of answering any questions. A lot of the tested information he does over in class and on the board so you'll have a tough time if you do not attend. He posts exam reviews that are really helpful for studying but no solutions.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--Would take again

reviews.comment: Great professor! Clearly cares about the students. Tests are difficult, but he grades fairly and curves. Explains difficult concepts clearly, and during review sessions tailors it to students' specific questions. Answers questions well.

Great prof. Understands and teaches the material very well. Tests are challenging but not overwhelming. Help outside of class is almost always available. If you attend class everyday there is no need to open a textbook because everything you need for his tests he explains in class.
